frequency_split: alternating frequency bins: even indices for fit, odd indices for validation

nominal_cold.description: Nominal load, cold-state reference; synthetic two-mass axis

heavy_load_cold.description: Higher table/workpiece inertia, cold state; synthetic two-mass axis

heavy_load_hot.description: Same heavy load, illustrative hot-state stiffness/damping drift

three_mode_reference.description: Three-inertia/two-coupling reference for second flexible mode

candidate_models.1: single rigid inertia and viscous damping; motor/load outputs constrained equal
candidate_models.2: two inertias coupled by one stiffness/damping element
candidate_models.3: three inertias coupled by two stiffness/damping elements; motor and final-load outputs observed

frf_estimator: H1 from independent repeated complex spectra; magnitude-squared coherence per output
model_selection: AICc on fit bins plus held-out validation normalized complex-FRF RMSE; no universal threshold
limitations: Synthetic linear models only; no current-loop or controller closed-loop implementation
No real torque sensor, encoder, thermal sensor or machine data
No controller gain/phase/disk margins are calculated; no controller has been designed
Directional friction intercept combines Coulomb friction and constant torque offset
Three-mass fit is an equivalent model, not proof of a physical component layout
Finite frequency grid and synthetic noise do not constitute equipment acceptance or safety evidence
